reviews.title: Too many advertisement!
reviews.text:
The idea of capturing multifaceted news all in one place is nice. However, the amount and number of advertisements make this app undesirable.
The articles get covered by ads in all parts of the screen rendering very little space for the actual article. Pop ups also happen often capturing the entire screen where you have to wait for the timer to allow you to close the ad.
All in all, for this app to be useful, its developers need to come up with a better scheme of representing ads not interrupting the article or covering 75% of the screen.

reviews.title: Not Worth Keeping — Inaccurate Content
reviews.text:
Too much misleading and unreliable content.
After using NewsBreak for a long time, I’ve found that a large portion of the articles are inaccurate, sensationalized, or written by questionable sources. I’ve seen multiple fake celebrity death stories, misleading headlines, and articles where the “breaking news” doesn’t even match the content.

A news app should be trustworthy by default. If I have to verify every story somewhere else just to know what’s real, then the app has no purpose.

I’m deleting NewsBreak and switching to reputable news sources that actually provide reliable information.

reviews.title: Could be a lot better
reviews.text:
I only use NewsBreak because it has some somewhat local news.  But there’s probably better apps for that.  I just haven’t taken the time to feel them out yet. 
NewsBreak is over-saturated with flashy ads. Yeah, I get that that’s how they pay the bills, but when they overtake 1/2 to 2/3 of the screen, that’s ridiculous. 
Video auto-advance needs to stop. Just because I clicked to view a video related to a news article I’m reading does not mean that I want to then immediately be bombarded with completely unrelated videos. And they’re always stupid videos, usually idiotic people doing idiotic things.  If I wanted TikTok, I’d go on TikTok. I don’t eve have TikTok. 
And turn off Reactions/Suggested Content or whatever you call it. Most of it is not even news, it’s just drivel. And comments can go away too. I use news apps to read the NEWS, not opinions spouted out from people I don’t even know.

reviews.title: Deleting this app
reviews.text:
This app has changed a lot in recent months and you’ll notice most of the happy reviews are older. I’ve tried multiple times to block contributors I don’t like, or product ads that are misleading, but that block only lasts a few days, and they’re back. I’ve gotten so tired of opening articles only to find they’re some sort of AI summary and not the actual article. I’m tired of clicking on “Watch til the end” videos that have no purpose… even if you watch to the end. Short videos posted by users that make absolutely no sense yet are still allowed. It is now full of AI created ads for products that many people would realize cannot deliver as advertised, but many people will spend their money on.
This app went from a source of news, entertainment, and funny/cute videos to becoming a disappointing, low standard, ad filled waste of time, mostly created or altered by AI. 
NewsBreak should be ashamed to call themselves a news source at this point.  Do better.
